parsed.rationale: Reasoning-effort settings are stated. Models are given only as family names (GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 3 32B; the text once says Qwen 3 30B) with no snapshot IDs or release dates, and no harness tag or commit is tied to the reported numbers. The README shows later releases (v1.2.x) changing the simulation.
